title: Wholesale inflation climbed to 11.39% in September
dek: Fuel and power prices rose 25.85% from a year earlier, the fastest of the major groups.
author: sarah-qureshi

body.text: Wholesale price inflation rose to 11.39% in September 2026 from 9.92% in August, according to Ministry of Commerce and Industry data published on 14 October. The all-India Wholesale Price Index stood at 112.5, up from 110.8 in August.
Fuel led, but the rise was broad

Fuel and power was the fastest-rising group, with prices up 25.85% from a year earlier, against 22.93% in August. Manufactured products rose 9.76%, up from 8.37%. Primary articles rose 8.67% and the WPI food index 8.66%.
Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, settled at $109.86 a barrel on 16 October.
A wide gap with retail prices

Wholesale inflation in September was more than twice the 5.54% recorded by the consumer price index. Wholesale prices capture what producers and traders pay, including fuel and industrial inputs, while the CPI tracks what households pay, including services. A gap this wide can close in either direction: producers may pass higher costs on to consumers, or input prices may ease.
